description: NaMnO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with ten equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₅ square pyramid, and  a faceface with one MnO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.50 Å. Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ square pyramids that share corners with ten equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids, and  a faceface with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-82°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.41 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Mn atoms.
